# Sub-Portal Governance: `tools/third_party/` (`AGENTS.md`)

This document defines the normative governance rules and consensus template for all documentation units under `docs/content/user/tools/third_party/` (including `nglview/`, `openmm/`, and `tleap/`).

## Scope & Purpose
Houses tutorial units and helper modules that facilitate zero-friction bridges and interoperability with third-party packages (NGLView, OpenMM, AmberTools tLEaP).

## Pages List & Paired Micro-`AGENTS.md` Files
- `index.md` ➔ `index.AGENTS.md`
- Sub-portals:
  - `nglview/` ➔ `nglview/AGENTS.md` (15 tutorial units)
  - `openmm/` ➔ `openmm/AGENTS.md`
    - `openmm/forces/` ➔ `openmm/forces/AGENTS.md` (9 tutorial units)
    - `openmm/platforms/` ➔ `openmm/platforms/AGENTS.md` (2 tutorial units)
    - `openmm/reporters/` ➔ `openmm/reporters/AGENTS.md` (3 tutorial units)
  - `tleap/` ➔ `tleap/AGENTS.md` (1 tutorial unit)

All 30 tool tutorial units have paired `<name>.ipynb.AGENTS.md` micro-governance files.
